title: The Jewish War (AD 66-70)
lead: The revolt of the Jews against Rome that began in the 60s AD, was fought first by Vespasian and then by his son Titus, and ended with the fall of Jerusalem and the destruction of its temple in AD 70. Josephus, a Jewish leader taken prisoner by Vespasian (Suetonius, Vespasian 5.6) and freed by him, tells it in his Jewish War; Tacitus gives a Roman summary in Histories 5:10-13.
